name: Aphelios
title: the Weapon of the Faithful

Q.name: Weapon Abilites
Q.summary: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon: Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack. Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons. Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon. Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon. Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

W.name: Phase
W.description: Swap main-hand and off-hand weapons, equipping Gravitum.
W.summary: Aphelios swaps his main-hand gun with his off-hand gun, replacing his basic attack and activated ability.

E.name: Weapon Queue System
E.summary: Aphelios has no third ability. This slot shows the next weapon Alune will give him. Weapon order begins fixed but may change over game time -- when a weapon is out of ammo it goes to the end of the order.

R.name: Moonlight Vigil
R.description: Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing 125/175/225 + 0.2×bonus AD + 1×AP physical damage to surrounding enemies. Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon. {{ Spell_ApheliosR_WeaponMod_(varies) }}
R.summary: Fire a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes on enemy champions. Applies the unique effect of Aphelios' main-hand gun.

Passive.name: The Hitman and the Seer
Passive.description: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Weapon-swapping hypercarry marksman; strength depends on which two of five guns he holds, peaking with strong combos and his R.
strengths: Huge damage once items are bought
Strong teamfight R with weapon effects
Many tools: slow (Gravitum root), heal (Severum), AoE (Infernum)
weaknesses: Weak early laning and weak level 1
Weapon order dictates his windows; bad combos are weak
profile.curveNote: Plays around his current main/off-hand guns; strongest with Calibrum or Infernum combos.

Q.notes: Gun-dependent: Calibrum long shot, Gravitum slow then root, Severum, Infernum, Crescendum.

R.notes: Blast that applies main-hand gun effect.

profile.windowAgainst: When he has no escape and his Gravitum root is down; early levels.
checks: Q cc depends on weapon; root only from Gravitum: check
